hooks.command: for d in ../agents-api ../openclawp; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then DIRTY=$(cd "$d" && git status -s 2>/dev/null | wc -l | xargs); BRANCH=$(cd "$d" && git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "${DIRTY:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then echo "⚠️  $(basename "$d") on $BRANCH: $DIRTY uncommitted file(s) — review before deploy"; fi; fi; done
hooks.description: Flag uncommitted work in the sibling plugins (agents-api, openclawp) at session start. Mantia deploys often pick up their state, so knowing they're dirty up front avoids deploying stale or in-progress substrate.

hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" == *mantia.php ]] || [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" == */mantia.php ]]; then echo '💡 Touching mantia.php — if you change Version:, bump MANTIA_VERSION constant in the same edit. CI lint.yml enforces no-drift.'; fi
hooks.description: Reminder when touching the plugin entry: Version header and MANTIA_VERSION constant must stay in lockstep. The lint workflow checks the invariant; this is a friendly nudge so we never get there.

hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" == *.php ]] && [[ -x vendor/bin/phpcbf ]]; then for f in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do if [[ "$f" == *.php ]] && [[ -f "$f" ]]; then vendor/bin/phpcbf -q "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; done; fi
hooks.description: Auto-fix PHPCS style violations on every .php edit. PHPCS would otherwise flag the same fixable issues on every CI run; running phpcbf locally first keeps diffs clean.

hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" == *.php ]]; then for f in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do if [[ "$f" == *.php ]] && [[ -f "$f" ]]; then OUT=$(php -l "$f" 2>&1); if echo "$OUT" | grep -qi 'parse error'; then echo "⚠️  Parse error in $f:"; echo "$OUT" | tail -3; fi; fi; done; fi
hooks.description: Run `php -l` on edited PHP files and surface only Parse errors. Catches syntax issues immediately rather than after a deploy + 500.
